maintainer_access: maintainer can administer; required checks still apply to pushes
notes: Required names are observed check-run names, not labels inferred from workflow titles.
Every required native/static/unit/platform/security job runs on every pull request to main.
Scorecard is push/manual only; daily reporting is scheduled/manual. Operator workflows are separately disabled and are not required source-stage contexts.
Path-filtered jobs must remain excluded from unconditional requirements if introduced.
Merge commits only, no force/deletion, no bypass, zero approvals and no code-owner requirement.
